newsitem.title: USA: Advanta prices $400 mln of mortgage loans.
newsitem.headline: Advanta prices $400 mln of mortgage loans.

text.p: Advanta Corp said on Thursday its Advanta Mortgage Conduit Services Inc, has priced $400 million of fixed rate and adjustable rate mortgage loans.
Fixed-rate loans were priced to yield 39 basis points over one-month LIBOR and adjustable rate loans at a rate of 30-basis points over one month LIBOR, Advanta said.
Closing is anticipated to be Sept. 25, 1996.

The certificates were sold in the public market by Morgan Stanley & Co as lead underwriter, Advanta said. Bear Stearns, Lehman Brothers and Prudential Securities were co-managers of the transaction, the company said..
